claims.claim_ar: حرف الاستثناء «إِلَّا» يعمل هنا على قصر الحكم واستبعاده عمّا عداه (استثناء ما ملكت أيمانكم من العموم).
claims.claim_en: The particle 'إِلَّا' functions to restrict the ruling, excluding everything except what follows (i.e., except what your right hands possess).
claims.rhetorical_effect: creates legal precision by excluding an otherwise general category; sharpens the scope of permission/forbiddance

claims.claim_ar: حرف الفاء في «فَمَا اسْتَمْتَعْتُمْ ... فَآتُوهُنَّ» يعمل رابطاً بين سبب شرطي ونتيجته — وصل وتفسير للحال السابقة.
claims.claim_en: The particle 'ف' in 'فَمَا اسْتَمْتَعْتُمْ ... فَآتُوهُنَّ' serves as a connective linking a conditional/circumstantial clause to its consequence—joining and explaining the preceding clause.
claims.rhetorical_effect: establishes logical sequence and causal/therapeutic relation between action and obligation

claims.source_quote_ar: غير: بدل من قوله: (مَنْ كانَ مُخْتالًا فَخُوراً) أو نصب على الذم.
claims.claim_ar: أداة «غَيْرَ» هنا تفيد الاستثناء أو التقييد بطرح البدائل؛ تُستخدم لغرض التحديد والتمييز بين المطلوب والمردود (غَيْرَ مُسَافِحِينَ).
claims.claim_en: The particle 'غَيْرَ' functions to exclude/contrast and thus specify/limit the meaning (as in 'غَيْرَ مُسَافِحِينَ'), used to mark distinction between the permitted/desired and the excluded.
claims.needs_review_reason: the cited chunk discusses usages of 'غير' in general; applying it to this specific juridical context is plausible but interpretive and should be reviewed against classical tafsir focused on this verse.
claims.rhetorical_effect: narrows semantic scope and accentuates the exception/limitation within the legal statement

claims.claim_ar: المشتق «مُحْصَنَات» يستند إلى معنى الحصن؛ اصطلاحاً كلمة تُسْتَخْدَم في مقام العفة والحماية — استعارة دالة على الحماية والعفاف.
claims.claim_en: The derivative 'muHsanat' is based on the notion of 'husn' (fortress); the term is used metaphorically to denote chastity/protection—an image of safeguarding and honor.
claims.needs_review_reason: the supporting substring defines 'الأطم' as 'الحصن' rather than discussing 'المحصنات' explicitly; applying this semantic note to assert metaphorical use in the verse is reasonable but indirect and should be reviewed with dedicated tafsir-balagha sources.
claims.rhetorical_effect: invokes imagery of protection and sanctity, strengthening the moral/legal tone through metaphor

warnings: Source chunks provided are mainly from al-Kashshaf (Zamakhshari) and Arabic i'rab notes; the original developer instruction listed other rhetoricians (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir balagha) whose texts were not supplied. Claims therefore rely on the supplied chunks and sometimes extend their general comments to this verse — such extensions are marked in needs_review_reason.

Some claims (notably the kinayah claim for "المحصنات" and the analysis of "غير") are inferential: the source substrings give lexical/semantic notes but do not explicitly analyze the verse's rhetorical device. Please review these with classical balagha/tafsir sources for confirmation.

No explicit substrings in the provided chunks discussed the particle 'إِنَّ' or the closing divine attributes in this verse; therefore devices related to iltifat, saj', or takrar were not asserted due to lack of direct support in the supplied sources.
